name: Notify
description: Push alerts on your phone through ntfy, Pushover or Telegram: when an agent asks you something or needs an approval, when a draft waits for you, when a run gets stuck, and a reminder when something waits longer than you like.
author: Remco Eijsackers

settings.label: ntfy topic
settings.help: On ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic can read it: pick a long random name, or use your own server with a token.

settings.label: Telegram chat ID
settings.help: Your own chat with the bot; send it a message, then look up the chat ID (see the README).

settings.label: Stuck runs, failed tasks and messages that did not go out
Remind me when something waits longer than (minutes, 0 = never)
Put the question or reason in the push (otherwise only the task)
Dashboard address for links in the push
settings.help: A link to localhost only opens on this Mac. Use an address your phone can reach (for example over Tailscale) to open it from the push.

secrets.label: ntfy access token (only for a protected topic)
